t: This is the statue of Sir Keith Park, standing beside the Athenaeum Club on Waterloo Place. It was made by the artist Les Johnson. Park was a New Zealand-born officer of the Royal Air Force. In the Second World War he led Number 11 Group, and his leadership was pivotal to the defeat of the Luftwaffe in the Battle of Britain. He rose to the rank of Air Chief Marshal, and this statue honours him in the heart of Westminster.
